data.title: Rochester Electronics Heads to electronica Munich 2026, Sponsors Women in Tech Forum
data.description: Rochester Electronics, based in Newburyport, Massachusetts, announced their participation at electronica Munich 2026 in Hall C4, Booth 161. The company will be co-hosting with WE United and sponsoring the Women in Tech Forum at the event.

data.title: Swap Appoints Michael Douroux as Chief Revenue Officer
data.description: In New York today, Swap, a commerce operating system tailored for the AI era, revealed the appointment of Michael Douroux as its new Chief Revenue Officer. With a backing from ICONIQ Growth and DST Global, Swap is intensifying its worldwide expansion, enhancing its commercial infrastructure to propel the next chapter of its operations. Douroux, known for his expertise in constructing global go-to-market structures within rapidly growing enterprise software firms, has a solid background, including close to nine years at Workday.

data.title: Momentous Introduces Daily Hydration, Built for the Hours Between the Work
data.description: In PARK CITY, Utah, a prominent human performance company, Momentous, introduced its inaugural dedicated hydration product called Daily Hydration. Unlike many electrolyte powders designed for intense exercise and excessive sweating but sold for daily use, Daily Hydration is tailored for regular activities like travel, work, mild exercise, and low-sweat situations. data.title: ADM’s Fourth Annual Regenerative Agriculture Report Highlights Growing Resilience Across the Food System
data.description: ADM, a leading company in natural solutions, has recently launched its fourth annual regenerative agriculture report. The report highlights the company's initiatives in supporting farmers, enhancing agricultural supply chains, and achieving significant environmental benefits globally. According to the report, focusing on soil health is crucial for enhancing resilience on farms. By investing in soil health, farmers can better adjust to evolving conditions and sustain productivity. ADM's efforts aim to strengthen agricultural practices and promote environmental sustainability. The company actively works towards improving farming techniques and protecting natural resources for a more resilient future.

data.title: Johnson Breeders Builds on Decade-Long MTech Partnership with Move to Amino
data.description: In Atlanta, Johnson Breeders, a leading poultry company involved in breeder operations, hatcheries, feed mills, processing, and broiler production, is advancing its technology modernization by transitioning its MTech software from Protein to Amino. This update marks the next phase in their partnership with MTech Systems, a part of Speria’s connected operational intelligence solutions, after over ten years of collaboration. Johnson Breeders aims to enhance data connectivity across its poultry operations through this transition.

data.title: The Coca-Cola System: A 140-Year Legacy That Continues to Deliver for America
data.description: In Atlanta, The Coca-Cola Company has grown from its original iconic beverage to around 200 brands over the past 140 years. These brands cover various categories such as sparkling soft drinks, waters, coffee, tea, juices, dairy, and plant-based drinks to cater to diverse consumer preferences. In the US, popular products include Coca-Cola, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Diet Coke, Sprite, Gold Peak, Powerade, Dasani, smartwater, BODYARMOR, Minute Maid, Simply, and fairlife.

data.title: Topsort Brings Global Commerce Leaders Together in Boston for Its Annual Product Gathering
data.description: A technology company based in Palo Alto, California, Topsort, unveiled the details for Topsort Fall Update 2026, scheduled to occur from September 29 to October 1 in Boston. The event, themed "Commerce, Evolved", will delve into the impact of AI on modern commerce. This includes changes in consumer shopping behaviors, decision-making processes within commerce enterprises, customer experience enhancement, implementation of monetization strategies, and adaptation to evolving customer preferences. The event aims to showcase the transformation of the commerce landscape.

data.title: Staples Marks 40 Years of Easy with New Brand Platform Challenging Businesses to Stop Choosing Hard
data.description: Staples, a leading office supply store, is celebrating its 40th anniversary with the launch of a new brand platform called Hard vs. Easy. This campaign emphasizes the concept that both businesses and individuals have the option to choose between doing things the Hard way or the Easy way. The initiative addresses the common challenges faced by businesses such as dealing with multiple vendors, inefficient processes, last-minute supply errands, varying quality, and unreliable delivery. Staples aims to provide solutions that streamline work processes and make tasks simpler for customers, highlighting the importance of efficiency and convenience in the modern workplace.

data.title: DoorDash and Wonder Announce Strategic Partnership
data.description: In an announcement made by DoorDash and Wonder, two prominent players in local commerce and food technology, a strategic partnership was revealed. The partnership involves DoorDash acquiring Wonder's Grubhub Campus Dining business, previously named Tapingo. This move allows DoorDash to tap into the market of millions of students who utilize campus dining facilities and on-campus restaurants through Grubhub Campus Dining. Additionally, DoorDash solidified its collaboration with Wonder by making a significant long-term investment in the company as part of Wonder's Series D funding round. This acquisition and investment mark a significant development in the local commerce and food technology sectors, showcasing the companies' commitment to innovation and expansion.

data.title: Gradiant Wins New Water Contracts for Major US Semiconductor Fabs in New York, Virginia, Idaho, and Utah
data.description: In Boston, Gradiant, a key player in the AI economy's water sector, revealed securing $300 million in fresh contracts from semiconductor manufacturing clients in 2026, showcasing robust commercial growth in an industry where water stability is increasingly vital for operational efficiency. The company achieved significant contract victories with various top semiconductor manufacturers globally, encompassing five production locations in New York, Virginia, Idaho, and Utah. The agreements involve various projects aimed at enhancing water efficiency and security.
